citations.narrative:
On July 30, 2026, the facility found four moribund and eight dead prairie voles in an outdoor enclosure. The facility
immediately euthanized the four moribund prairie voles. The facility transported sixteen prairie voles from a temperature
controlled indoor facility and introduced them directly into the new outdoor enclosure without an acclimation period the
previous afternoon. At the time of placement, the ambient temperature was 30.6°C (87°F), and temperatures reached
35.6°C (96°F) on the day the affected animals were discovered.
The enclosure provided only plastic vole houses and limited grass cover, which did not offer adequate protection from
high temperatures. The lack of acclimation to significantly warmer environmental conditions, combined with insufficient
shelter from heat exposure, placed the animals at risk for discomfort, hyperthermia, and death. The facility determined
that this resulted in the mortality and morbidity observed.
The facility must ensure natural or artificial shelter appropriate to the local climatic conditions for the species concerned
shall be provided for all animals kept outdoors to afford them protection and to prevent discomfort to such animals.
Individual animals shall be acclimated before they are exposed to the extremes of the individual climate.
Corrective actions to ensure heat acclimation and provide appropriate shelter were implemented prior to the inspection,
and no additional issues have occurred since these measures were put in place.
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with the attending veterinarian and the IACUC director.
You may appeal all or part of any inspection report by submitting a written statement contesting the findings—along with
any supporting documentation—to the Deputy Administrator. Appeals of routine, focused, or attempted inspections must
be received within 21 days of report issuance as shown by the signature line of this report.
Appeals may be sent by email to AnimalCare@usda.gov.
Appeals sent by mail should be addressed to:
Deputy Administrator
APHIS Animal Care (AC)
U.S. Department of Agriculture
2150 Centre Avenue, Building B
Mailstop #3W11
Fort Collins, CO 80526-8117
